title: U-Line — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for U-Line.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Premium Undercounter." Premium tier. U-Line pioneered the residential undercounter refrigerator market in 1962. Now part of Middleby Corporation, they make ice makers, wine captains, beverage centers, and convertible refrigerator-freezers. Their 2000 and 3000 series cover every undercounter need.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Kitchen islands needing undercounter cooling. Entertainment areas. Wet bars.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for U-Line:

• Invented the residential undercounter refrigerator in 1962

• Widest selection of undercounter formats — fridge, freezer, wine, ice, beverage

• Convertible models switch between fridge and freezer

• Middleby Corporation backing and quality standards

• Available in 15-inch and 24-inch widths for flexible installation
